title: perf: reduce Console and RichHandler import time by deferring unused imports

comments.author: willmcgugan
comments.body:
We can't use `sys._getframe`, give it is private, and the docs say this:

> CPython implementation detail: This function should be used for internal and specialized purposes only. It is not guaranteed to exist in all implementations of Python.

What I'd suggest is making `currentframe` default to None, and do the import inside this method.

I think the only reason it is exposed is for tests.
comments.label: issue
comments.rationale: Defaults to sys._getframe, a CPython implementation detail that is not guaranteed on other Python implementations: a portability bug.

comments.author: willmcgugan
comments.body: Why import them with al alternate name?
comments.label: not_issue
comments.rationale: Question about an import alias; naming preference.
